Job Description: **Who are we?**



Marks is a global brand design and experience agency, uniquely constructed to enable brands to win in an age of constant change. Marks is part of the Propelis Group, a brand impact group that enables its household\-name clients to get there first – empowering acceleration on a global scale. From vision\-building to detailed execution, we enable brands to move faster and shift impact. (www.makemarks.com (https://www.makemarks.com/))



We are the next\-gen creative platform, working at the collision of people, commerce, creativity and technology – purpose\-built for the world’s most ambitious brands, delivering content at the speed of culture.


**About the team**



Our Content Solutions team is the CGI and content engine of the agency – a specialist group of art directors, CGI artists, retouchers and producers who create photorealistic 3D product and packaging imagery for the world’s biggest CPG brands. We turn physical products into pixel\-perfect renders, building the assets, systems and libraries that power campaigns across retail, ecommerce, social, digital and beyond. A multidisciplinary group of makers and problem\-solvers, we pair technical craft with sharp creative judgement to deliver work at the top tier of the industry.


**About the Role**



This position calls for a highly collaborative team member with a creative spark, developing design abilities, strong communication skills, passion, and self\-motivation. Working under the direction of an Art Director, you will help bring high\-caliber, photorealistic CGI product and packaging work to life, informed by a strategic framework and brand narrative.



As an Associate 3D / CGI Art Director you contribute to big ideas and, above all, help execute them across different touchpoints and mediums – supporting the team as work is presented and sold internally and to clients.



You have a developing design eye and growing hands\-on CGI prowess, paired with conceptual thinking that is beginning to address client needs and business goals. You are eager to move from supporting ideas to crafting high\-impact photoreal renders, and you are keen to learn across channels – social and digital as well as retail programs, in\-store communications, ecommerce, packaging and beyond. You help uphold the quality bar for the creative product of the company at a level that is amongst the top tier within the industry.



You’ll work with teams across our entire global Marks ecosystem, on an exciting range of clients and categories, including toys, food \& beverage, beer, wine, spirits, technology, personal care, beauty, retail, and many more.


**On any given day you might**


* Craft photorealistic 3D CGI product and packaging renders for global CPG brands, under the direction of a Creative Director.
* Support the development of assigned work from inception to final delivery, helping maintain a unified artistic direction and high creative standard.
* Contribute across the CGI production process – modelling, texturing, lighting, look\-dev, rendering, compositing and retouching – with growing ownership of your tasks.
* Collaborate with Art Directors, Designers, Retouchers and CGI artists to keep projects on time while helping ensure a high level of quality.
* Help track production tasks with a keen eye towards deadlines and resourcing on your projects.
* Communicate the status of your work, prioritized goals and updated timelines to the Creative Director and project teams regularly.
* Help prepare files and assets for internal quality control ahead of client delivery.
* Develop supporting campaign visuals that bring the team’s ideas to life.
* Actively participate in brainstorming sessions and internal reviews.
* Keep up to date with the latest trends and innovations – exploring ways to leverage AI and emerging tools to advance our work.


**The ideal person**


* Is a hands\-on CGI creative who loves to roll up their sleeves and get things done, working toward a photoreal standard.
* Has a solid working understanding of the CGI process – modelling, texturing, look\-dev, lighting, rendering, compositing and retouching – and a hunger to deepen it.
* Has experience contributing to CGI production as part of a team.
* Has a foundational knowledge of technical and traditional art process within CGI production pipelines.
* Is comfortable working under performance constraints and open to feedback and direction.
* Has a keen eye for detail and the ability to produce quality visuals to tight deadlines.
* Demonstrates developing decision\-making and strong communication skills, and is eager to learn from other team members.
* Can work both as part of a team and, increasingly, with autonomy in a fast\-paced environment.
* Is innately curious, with an instinct for popular culture and the ways photoreal CGI is evolving.


**You Bring**


* Degree or diploma in CGI / Advertising \& Marketing, or related field is preferred, but not required.
* A minimum of 3\+ years’ experience in CGI as an artist.
* 1\+ years of experience in CPG\-focused content production is an asset.
* A portfolio showcasing photorealistic product and packaging renders and a developing understanding of campaign work across print, digital, social content and motion.
* Working fluency in content creation software with a focus on CGI – DCCs such as Houdini, Maya \& C4D, rendering in V\-Ray, Redshift and/or Karma. Working knowledge of the Adobe and Substance suites.
* Knowledge of and interest in emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted workflows.

Marks is part of the Propelis Group, a brand impact group that enables its household\-name clients to get there first – empowering acceleration on a global scale. From vision\-building to detailed execution, we enable brands to move faster and shift impact. (www.makemarks.com (https://www.makemarks.com/))



We are the next\-gen creative platform, working at the collision of people, commerce, creativity and technology – purpose\-built for the world’s most ambitious brands, delivering content at the speed of culture.


**About the team**



Our Content Solutions team is the CGI and content engine of the agency – a specialist group of art directors, CGI artists, retouchers and producers who create photorealistic 3D product and packaging imagery for the world’s biggest CPG brands. We turn physical products into pixel\-perfect renders, building the assets, systems and libraries that power campaigns across retail, ecommerce, social, digital and beyond. A multidisciplinary group of makers and problem\-solvers, we pair technical craft with sharp creative judgement to deliver work at the top tier of the industry.


**Position Overview**



As the Associate Creative Director, 3D / CGI, you will report to the Creative Director, Innovation as part of the Content Solutions team. You’ll lead CGI Art Directors and artists to creatively solve clients’ business problems, ensuring that photorealistic product and packaging work brings the strategy to life – successfully, on brief and on time. You will need to showcase an ability to work within teams, as well as demonstrate the independence and resourcefulness demanded by an agile and highly dynamic agency environment. A strong communicator, you are able to present and sell ideas internally and to clients with passion and energy.



The ACD embodies Marks’ vision of can\-do positivity, agility in approach, and belief in the power of co\-creation – ensuring we deliver the best solution against each brief. You use strong judgement and analytical skills to drive the creative process from early concepts to final photoreal render, delivering beyond client expectations while owning the CGI quality bar across your accounts.



You are responsible for building and growing your team to deliver against increasing client needs and demand – staffing, structuring, and empowering CGI project teams to deliver high\-caliber work. You partner with client services and operations teams to establish workflow processes, schedule resources across the CGI pipeline, and ensure timelines are met.


**Critical Skills and Behaviours**


**Strategic and conceptual skills**


* Takes responsibility for the success of the Content Solutions CGI/art direction teams and the clients they serve.
* Acts as a creative and quality guardian for key account(s), owning the photoreal standard from concept to final delivery.
* Ensures the team is consistently developing ideas and CGI work, from concept to execution, that deliver on a strategic framework.
* Is an expert in producing photorealistic 3D product and packaging imagery and integrated content across retail, in\-store, ecommerce, digital, social and out\-of\-home channels.
* Has deep command of the CGI pipeline – modelling, texturing, look\-dev, lighting, rendering, compositing and retouching – and can direct artists across all of it.
* Experience concepting and developing motion and video content, including online video, social content and broadcast, alongside still CGI.
* Is as comfortable leading as jumping into a project to support the team through execution and hands\-on look\-dev.
* Leads and oversees the development of presentation deck narratives that frame and sell CGI approaches.
* Has a keen eye for detail and is thorough in reviewing the work of the team, from junior artists upward.
* Works with speed and agility while maintaining a high photoreal quality bar through execution.


**Leadership**


**With clients:**


* Presents themselves as a trusted expert, collaborative partner and seamless extension of the client’s team.
* Demonstrates empathy for and prioritizes the client’s specific business objectives.
* Supports new business and new work streams by attending kick\-offs and planning for CGI ingestion and resourcing.


**Within the broader agency:**


* Collaborates with Marks global offices to support CGI and content production across the agency at large.
* Partners with the leadership team to establish best practices, methods, tools and pipeline standards leveraged by the Marks collective.
* Acts as a consultant, extending CGI subject\-matter expertise across the collective.


**Within the team:**


* Plans for and mobilizes teams to deliver across various streams of CGI work.
* Provides direction and guidance to team members to ensure efficient and high\-quality delivery.
* Manages and supports the growth and development of CGI Art Directors and artists.
* Works with recruiting partners to staff a balanced team of full\-time and freelance CGI talent.
* Partners with scheduling departments and operations teams to resource work and manage overhead costs.


**Collaboration and culture**


* Is a cultural ambassador and “lightning rod” for Marks.
* Upholds a culture that values teamwork over egos.
* Actively leads effective internal review meetings and team sessions.
* Leads by example – working constructively and demonstrating respect for each team, discipline, and business partner.
* Creates strong internal partnerships at every level, from juniors to senior leaders, across the Marks agency at large.
* Lives and breathes CGI, content and design – gets excited to share and talk shop.


**Agility and improvement**


* Possesses an open mindset and is focused on continuous improvement of craft and pipeline.
* Demonstrates a roll\-up\-your\-sleeves\-and\-get\-it\-done attitude.
* Is un\-phased by change and proactively seeks solutions to problems and challenges.
* Can pivot and prioritize multiple streams of work so the team can meet assigned deadlines.
* Thrives in a fast\-paced work environment and continually creates efficiencies and improves processes.
* Explores emerging technologies, including AI\-assisted CGI workflows, to advance the team’s output.


**Minimum Requirements**


* Diploma / degree in CGI, Advertising \& Marketing, or a related field is recommended, but not required.
* 5\+ years of experience in CGI / content production, with a strong focus on photorealistic CPG product and packaging work.
* Experience leading teams and managing people within a CGI or content production environment.
* Expert fluency across the CGI pipeline and its tools – DCCs such as Houdini, Maya \& C4D, rendering in a mix of V\-Ray, Redshift and Karma, plus strong command of the Adobe and Substance suites. Fluency in Keynote / PowerPoint.
* A well\-rounded portfolio showcasing strong, innovative creative ideas, photoreal execution, presentation skills and an excellent understanding of different communication spaces, mediums and approaches.

Reporting to the Controller, the Accounting Clerk is responsible for the provision of services relating to OCAD University’s (OCAD U) cash receipts and the performance of other accounting tasks within the Finance office.
Summary of Responsibilities
:
Bookkeeping
Receive cash, cheques, and credit cards; issue receipts for all cash/cheque/credit card transactions, prepare daily cash reconciliations and perform cash float box count
Record miscellaneous cash receipts
Process online credit/debit card payments
Perform data entry of books of original accounts, and operating and capital budgets as necessary
Calculate and allocate HST on all cash receipts
Reconcile ancillary revenue, student loan and student financial assistance bursary accounts
Assist in the full cycle and reporting of accounts payable and receivables
Prepare General Ledger (GL) accounts analysis and reconciliations, and year-end audit working papers
Assist with financial reporting and analysis
Process non-credit course payments
Assist studio facilities staff with recording and reconciling sales of class material supplies
Summarize actual transfer, budget transfers, internal compensation transfers and stock transfer monthly journal entries
Record and reconcile transactions for online commerce system
Accounts Payable
Distribute all cheques
Perform data entry for EFT payments
Provide back-up support and relief for Senior Accounts Payable/Accounts Receivable Clerk, when needed
Student Accounts
Work with the Student Finance Administrator in providing students with information regarding fee assessments, refunds, payments, and outstanding balances
Provide back-up support and relief for Student Finance Administrator, when needed
General
Assist with implementation of online commerce system
Assist the Controller in special projects as required
Assist the Controller in the development of policies & procedures regarding the University’s cash transactions
Assist with IT system related projects and process improvements, including the implementation of university wide changes, technology upgrades, workplace culture initiatives, and sustainability.
Assist in the implementation, upgrade testing, documentation and ongoing administration of Colleague and other Finance office systems
Support the Director, Finance and Controller in other related duties that contribute to the successful operation of the Finance office, and maintain confidentiality as required
Qualifications:
Post-secondary diploma in accounting, business, finance or equivalent
Minimum of one (1) year of accounting work experience, or equivalent, with demonstrated strength in customer service
Strong mathematical and computer skills, and a working knowledge of all Microsoft office applications
Demonstrated attention to detail and the ability to prioritize tasks and meet deadlines
Strong interpersonal and oral & written communication skills
Demonstrated commitment to the principles of equity and diversity, and experience promoting a respectful work and learning environment for students, staff and faculty

OPSEU Unit I, Appendix A, Grade A2; $42,729.45 to $58,762.95 per annum
